title: Bumblebee waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#bfe9ff' transform='rotate(-25 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='26' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#d8f3ff' transform='rotate(15 52 26)'/>
  <!-- wing veins -->
  <line x1='30' y1='30' x2='44' y2='27' stroke='#8fd0ef' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='26' x2='58' y2='24' stroke='#8fd0ef' stroke-width='1.4'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#ffd21f'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M30 44 Q50 52 70 44 L70 52 Q50 60 30 52 Z' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <path d='M29 62 Q50 70 71 62 L69 70 Q50 78 31 70 Z' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#f2a900' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='15' fill='#ffd21f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#f2a900' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='4.4' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='4.4' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <circle cx='45.6' cy='30.6' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.6' cy='30.6' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 40 Q50 45 56 40' fill='none' stroke='#a2610a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='44' y1='21' x2='39' y2='12' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='11' r='2.6' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='21' x2='61' y2='12' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='11' r='2.6' fill='#2b2140'/>

  <!-- waving arm up on the right -->
  <path d='M70 50 Q82 44 82 32' fill='none' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='6' fill='#ffd21f'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#f2a900' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='27' r='1.7' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='25.5' r='1.7' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='27' r='1.7' fill='#2b2140'/>

  <!-- other arm down on the left -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q22 62 20 70' fill='none' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='72' r='5' fill='#ffd21f'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='72' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#f2a900' stroke-width='1.6'/>

  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 80 L46 88 L54 88 Z' fill='#2b2140'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M42 76 Q38 84 34 86' fill='none' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 76 Q62 84 66 86' fill='none' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
